hypothesis: A burst of injection-style requests against the training web app is distinguishable from normal browsing by payload patterns and error-rate change, and Zeek/Suricata plus proxy logs correlate to the same client.

benign_control.description: benign-browser walks the Juice Shop catalog, search, and login pages from red-01 at normal pace.
benign_control.differs_by: request payload content (injection strings vs ordinary search terms); same source, target, and volume band

steps.action: http-replay sends the fixed request set fixtures/web-001-requests.txt to http://juice-01.northstar.lab:3000
steps.expected: Juice Shop returns errors for a subset of requests; proxy and app logs record each request
steps.stop_condition: any response from a host other than juice-01, or more than 500 requests

expected_triage.detection: a web-injection rule fires for the adversary run and not for the benign control

cleanup: Restart juice-01 from its image to discard application state
